name: unmissablerp
description: Official website for UNMISSABLERP - a FiveM GTA RP community. Next.js, whitelist applications, live stats, server assets.

paragraphs: A modern, animated FiveM GTA RP (Grand Theft Auto roleplay) community website. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Whitelist applications, live server stats, server assets management, and Discord integration — designed for serious roleplay communities.

UNMISSABLERP is a FiveM GTA RP server and community focused on serious roleplay, a living economy, and high-stakes stories. This repository is the official community website: landing page, whitelist application form, public stats dashboard, store placeholder, and server assets management (scripts, MLOs, vehicles).
features: Serious RP, zero nonsense — Curated whitelist keeps quality high.
Economy that breathes — Player-driven businesses and supply/demand.
Events that matter — Heists, elections, turf wars; choices ripple through the city.
